findings.description: Critical: Work package dependency DAG is inconsistent with implementation requirements. wp-prioritize can start before wp-producers, but ranking requires all three producer implementations to be complete. Similarly, wp-integration exercises all producers but doesn't explicitly depend on wp-producers.
findings.resolution: Add wp-producers to wp-prioritize.depends_on and ensure wp-integration transitively depends on all producer implementations. This aligns the DAG with the actual implementation dependencies described in tasks.md.

findings.description: Nit: wp-producers write scope excludes test directories for bug-scrub and improve-harness skills, preventing updates to canonical skill-contract tests during implementation.
findings.resolution: Add skills/tests/bug-scrub and skills/tests/improve-harness to wp-producers.write_allow to enable comprehensive test coverage for all producer implementations.

findings.description: FYI: The plan correctly establishes clear contracts for candidate-work generation, validation, ranking, and roadmap integration. The additive sidecar approach maintains backward compatibility while enabling deterministic processing.
findings.resolution: Accept these well-defined boundaries as they promote robust implementation and testing patterns.

findings.description: FYI: The separation of concerns between producers, ranking, and roadmap intake is well-designed, promoting modularity and testability. Each component has a single responsibility with clear interfaces.
findings.resolution: Maintain these architectural boundaries during implementation to ensure clean separation of concerns.

findings.description: FYI: The plan includes comprehensive test scenarios covering success cases, error conditions, and edge cases for all components. This demonstrates thorough thinking about validation requirements.
findings.resolution: Ensure all specified test scenarios are implemented and passing before considering the feature complete.
